title: Cache latents to disk instead of encoding images with the VAE every step
finding: Encoding every step cost about 5 GB of GPU memory above training itself, so caching latents was made mandatory for every recipe.

title: Use PyTorch's expandable memory segments for training runs
finding: Without it every step failed for lack of 5 GB while 5 GB sat reserved but fragmented; with it the run trained, so the trainer now launches with it by default.
